quote: From 1 January to 29 December 2024, a total of 177 570 cholera cases were reported across 18 countries in the African Region. The highest number of cases were reported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (31 135)
notes: WHO Multi-country outbreak of cholera, External Situation Report n. 22 (document text: 'published 24 January 2025'; 'Data as of 29 December 2024').
